messages:
leah: Heads up — marketplace SKU `rwd-appliance-v1` is slated for deprecation next quarter. We need a coordinated plan for crediting displaced customers, partner comms (HW/SI), and the field announcement timeline. Thoughts?

samir: Do we have counts and dollar exposure? rough ballpark will help shape credit policy.

leah: ~230 active customers, ~$2.1M ARR tied to that SKU, 40% on private offers. A chunk are on 1yr renewals this quarter.

jordan: Legal: any credits tied to deprecation must be documented as "one-time migration credit" vs recurring discount. We should avoid changing MSAs mid-term — prefer addenda.

maya: For SIs — they need a migration path and co-sell credit. Recommend: 1) replacement SKU mapping 2) transient credit (6mo) or one-time credit to cover migration work 3) enable explicit private-offer transition.

samir: Ballpark credit structures we should evaluate: 1) Trade-in credit = unused prorated prepaid balance; 2) Migration stipend = fixed $X for SI-led migrations; 3) Enrollment bonus if they convert to new reserved commit within 60 days. Which mix?

leah: I like 2 + 3 for high-touch customers (private offers). For self-serve customers, prorated refund/credit. Need to keep unit economics intact.

jordan: Ops/legal ask: sample addendum language (two lines) we can drop into private offers. I'll draft.

maya: Field comms: suggest staged notification — 45d pre-deprecation notice for customers on auto-renew, 30d for others, and an SI partner briefing 60d out. Also create FAQ for marketplace listing owners.

announce-bot: Reminder: Product deprecation announcement template available at https://confluence.redwood/deprecation-template

samir: Numbers check: if we give a fixed migration stipend of $5k to 50 customers, that's $250k plus lost revenue risk. Approve if ROI on retained ARR > 3x.

leah: Agreed. Prioritize customers with annual ARR > $10k for stipend; sub-$10k get prorated credit. That halves eligible list.

maya: Can we loop in partner marketing for joint announcement? HW partner needs co-branded FAQ + timing alignment. @samir can you own partner PM sync?

samir: Yep — I'll set a meeting with HW PM and top 3 SI leads tomorrow.

jordan: I'll upload draft addendum to the thread later today.

leah: Action items: Samir — partner PM sync; Jordan — addendum text; Maya — field comms + FAQ; I'll draft credit policy spreadsheet. We should aim to publish partner playbook 21 days before EOD on the notification cadence.

maria: quick q — will this affect marketplace pricing floor?

leah: Good call — no change to public pricing floor. Credits are one-time, non-recurring and instrumented outside the SKU price.

samir: Meeting scheduled: Wed 11am PT with HW PM + SI lead list. I'll post notes here.

leah: Thanks team. I'll drop initial credit policy spreadsheet by EOD for review.

maria: :thumbsup:
